t: The Blast Furnace is a 3x3x4 brick structure, hollow in the middle, for converting Iron Ingots into Steel Ingots.$(br2)The Oven is built out of 34 special bricks made from Nether Brick, Soul Sand, and Magma Cream. If broken down, it takes 36 Nether Bricks, 36 Soul Sand, and 9 Magma Creams to build one Blast Furnace. Blast Furnaces cannot be built adjacent to each other – there must be at least one tile in between Furnaces.
高炉是一种3×3×4尺寸的砖砌结构，中间为空心，用于将铁锭冶炼成钢锭。$(br2)该烤炉由34块特殊砖块构成，原料为下界砖、灵魂沙与岩浆膏。若将其拆除，重建一座高炉需消耗36块下界砖、36份灵魂沙与9份岩浆膏。高炉之间不可相邻建造——两座高炉间至少需间隔一格空间。
